svg.title: Chime in
svg.desc: Expression asks the shared rates node for an extra hike scenario; the owner delegates it to a new child that Expression joins directly.

text.tspan: Expression has joined Rates path, which is answering Financing's base-case question.
Expression chimes in: it needs this too, plus one more aspect,
a two-hike scenario. Async, no rush.
Rates path owns its question. A hike scenario would change its answer
for Financing, so it delegates the aspect to a child instead of absorbing it.
It tells Expression about the new node, and Expression joins it directly.
Absorb, delegate or decline is the owner's call: it knows who depends on it.
The harness only keeps each node's question fixed.
